rules.title: City of San Diego Tenant Protection Ordinance
rules.requirement: Buyout agreements must be in writing, handed to each tenant at signing, and carry bold 14-point statements of tenant rights, with translations where the tenant negotiated in another language; buyouts below the relocation assistance owed, or waiving ordinance rights, are void. Tenants may sue for injunctive relief and damages, and can raise violations as an affirmative defense in unlawful detainer.
rules.key_value: Damages of at least 3x actual economic damages for wrongful eviction; at least 3x required relocation assistance plus actual damages if relocation assistance is not paid
rules.penalty: Civil liability for at least 3x actual economic damages (wrongful eviction); at least 3x unpaid relocation assistance plus actual economic damages; punitive damages; attorney's fees and costs in non-unlawful-detainer civil actions
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7
rules.status_basis: Document refers to termination notices served before June 24, 2023 as the effective period.
rules.quoted_span: Buyout agreements for amounts less than the amount of relocation assistance available to Tenant is void. Buyout agreements which attempt to waive or limit a Tenant’s rights under this Ordinance are contrary to public policy and void.
